phase_name: Part A -- A Recommendation Asserting a Measurable Property of the Corpus

objectives.description: Rewrite the Out-of-scope paragraph to draw the line at falsifiability-by-corpus-re-measurement
State the trigger for an in-scope recommendation
State the discharge rule and define the new CORPUS-UNVERIFIED token
Keep the convention's purpose intact and visible
Give canonical positive and negative instances
Add a pointer in general-research-agent.md's report-writing stage
Confirm six existing trigger shapes unchanged in meaning

notes: Rewrote the Out-of-scope paragraph so the line it draws is falsifiability-by-re-measurement-against-the-live-corpus rather than a categorical recommendation exclusion, then added a new paragraph stating the in-scope recommendation trigger, the discharge rule (run the proposed rule and report inline, or mark CORPUS-UNVERIFIED naming both the corpus and the rule), the canonical positive instance (the depth-counter marker-parser recommendation that plan-time re-measurement showed non-behaviour-preserving over five source-store test suites) and canonical negative instance (a pure design preference), plus a closing sentence keeping the convention's purpose visible. Defined CORPUS-UNVERIFIED as a new, distinct token (never CARRIED-UNVERIFIED) with the same required-named-argument rule and greppability terms. Added a pointer-only sentence to general-research-agent.md's Stage 6 (Create Research Report), right after the required-section-headings paragraph, naming report-format.md's Carried-Figure Discipline section by name and copying no normative text. Verified by grep: no sentence remains anywhere in report-format.md asserting a recommendation is categorically out of scope or that an interpretive claim is unfalsifiable without the corpus qualification; plan-format.md's own carried-figure paragraph is untouched and still only points by name (it references CARRIED-UNVERIFIED only, not CORPUS-UNVERIFIED, which is correct since Phase 4 only adds the new token to report-format.md's own text, not to plan-format.md); general-research-agent.md's new sentence names the section by name and contains no normative CARRIED-UNVERIFIED-discipline text of its own. The six trigger shapes (lines ~86-94) are confirmed byte-unchanged by direct comparison against the pre-Phase-3/4 text. Ran the 'Internal consistency' reviewer prompt by hand against the full amended section (Definition through the new recommendation paragraphs through Enforcement-level): no assertion requires the ABSENCE of a string a mandated literal requires PRESENT, and no stated risk/prediction contradicts a measured result elsewhere in the section.
